metadata.description: Official Squad plugin marketplace — curated sub-plugins for the Squad multi-agent runtime

plugins.name: squad-core
plugins.description: Full Squad coordinator agent and all team skills. The complete Squad experience in one plugin.

plugins.name: squad-agents
plugins.description: All 20 named Squad team member agents: Flight (Lead), EECOM (Core Dev), FIDO (QA), CAPCOM (SDK), CONTROL (TypeScript), and more.

plugins.name: squad-team-workflow
plugins.description: Team workflow and governance skills: agent collaboration patterns, conduct rules, reviewer protocol, architectural proposals, history hygiene, and more.

plugins.name: squad-release
plugins.description: Release and versioning skills: release process checklist, semver versioning policy, CI validation gates, and git workflow.

plugins.name: squad-security
plugins.description: Security and compliance skills: secret handling rules, GitHub multi-account auth isolation, and PII/credential hygiene.

plugins.name: squad-orchestration
plugins.description: Orchestration skills: per-agent model selection, client compatibility, distributed mesh coordination, economy mode, session recovery, and personal squad setup.

plugins.name: squad-devrel
plugins.description: Developer relations and community skills: external communications workflow, tone enforcement, and PR screenshot capture.
